references.text: Abimelech becomes king of Israel after killing his brothers, which explains the background to his three-year reign.
Gideon refused to become king of Israel, but his son Abimelech later seized power himself.
After three years of rule, God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem, marking the beginning of his downfall.
God's judgment on Abimelech for his wickedness, which ends his short reign of three years.
Parallel to leadership periods in Israel - Saul also ruled over Israel for a certain number of years.
